info.definition: Money lost between revenue and profit: over-used projects, extra revisions, internal time over its allowance, and paid capacity nobody used. Judged as a share of revenue.
info.formula: L1 + L2 + L3 + L4; status on F4 ÷ F1

leaks.label: Over-used projects

change.tooltip: Was 0 USD in 1–11 Aug 2026 · 1–11 Aug 2026 is the part of the period recorded: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Over-used projects
info.definition: For each project with a fee: the hours at cost spent beyond what the fee earned in the period had left after its direct costs -- never more than the hours themselves cost, so no cost is counted twice. Fee earned is the retainer's monthly fee, or the project's fee times the share of its estimate delivered in the period.
info.formula: Σ min(hours × cost rate, max(0, hours × cost rate + direct costs − fee earned)), fee projects
info.source: Time entries, cost rates, client accounts, retainers terms

leaks.detail: No project spent beyond its fee.

change.tooltip: Was 0 USD in 1–11 Aug 2026 · 1–11 Aug 2026 is the part of the period recorded: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Extra revisions
info.definition: Hours logged on a task after it was sent back more times than the included revision rounds, at each person's cost rate on the day.
info.formula: Σ hours after the send-back beyond the included rounds × cost rate
info.source: Task history, time entries, cost rates

leaks.label: Internal time over allowance

change.tooltip: Was 93 USD in 1–11 Aug 2026 (+100.2%) · 1–11 Aug 2026 is the part of the period recorded: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Internal time over allowance
info.definition: Personal and internal hours beyond the allowance (a share of capacity, set in Control panel → Settings), at the average cost rate of those hours.
info.formula: max(0, internal hours − allowance × capacity) × average cost rate

leaks.detail: 2.6h of internal and personal time above the allowance of 30% of capacity.

leaks.label: Idle paid capacity

change.tooltip: Was 4,410 USD in 1–11 Aug 2026 (+373.5%) · 1–11 Aug 2026 is the part of the period recorded: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Idle paid capacity
info.definition: Paid hours nobody logged: for each person, capacity less every hour they logged, at their cost rate.
info.formula: Σ per person max(0, capacity − logged) × cost rate

leaks.detail: 290h of paid capacity with nothing logged.
